en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tree-lined promenade in a town. A cobbled foreground leads into an avenue of tall trees with people walking in the distance. On the left is a woman in a long dress holding an umbrella near a small kiosk or stand set against a large tree, with a building partially visible behind. The lower part of the card has printed red German text identifying the view as a promenade in Grimma and the publisher's imprint.
